# ==================================================================================================
#  check-jsonschema.txt - THE HASH-LOCKED PYTHON GRAPH FOR THE CHARACTERIZATION SCHEMA GATE
#  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR
#  .github/workflows/ci.yml validates the fifteen characterization workflow definitions against
#  characterization/workflows/workflow.schema.json with `check-jsonschema`. Naming that one package at
#  a version pinned nothing but the package a human typed: pip resolved fourteen further
#  distributions at install time from whatever was current, so the code CI executed was not the code
#  anyone reviewed, and a compromised or yanked-and-republished transitive would have run inside a job
#  that reads this repository (CWE-494, CWE-1104, CWE-1357).
#
#  WHAT MAKES IT A LOCK RATHER THAN A LIST
#  Every distribution in the closure is named with `==` and carries the SHA-256 of every file pip may
#  legitimately select for it. `pip install --require-hashes` then refuses to install anything whose
#  digest is not written here - including a transitive dependency that would otherwise have been
#  resolved silently - and `--require-hashes` additionally refuses the whole install if ANY
#  requirement lacks a pin or a hash, so this file cannot be half-applied.
#
#  WHY EVERY FILE OF A VERSION IS HASHED RATHER THAN JUST ONE
#  pip selects a distribution file by interpreter tag and platform at install time, so hashing only
#  the file this host happened to download would break the moment the runner image changed its Python
#  minor version. The set below is every `py3-none-any` wheel, every CPython 3.10+ Linux x86_64 wheel
#  and every source distribution published for the pinned version - which is the whole set reachable
#  on the documented `ubuntu-latest` runner. A runner on another platform fails LOUDLY with a hash
#  mismatch rather than quietly installing something unreviewed, which is the correct direction to
#  fail in.
#
#  HOW TO REGENERATE IT
#      python3 -m pip download 'check-jsonschema==<new version>' -d /tmp/closure
#      # then, for each name==version in the closure, read every file's digests.sha256 from
#      # https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json and rewrite the blocks below.
#  Install is additionally constrained with `--only-binary :all:` in the workflow, so no sdist is
#  ever built; the sdist hashes are present so that a pip which chooses one is still verified rather
#  than refused for an absent hash.
#
#  RULES
#  review_rules reports that no user rules were provided, so no user-specified rule governs this file.
# ==================================================================================================
